edits.match: Propranolol for migraine prevention, tremor, anxiety symptoms and thyroid storm; metoprolol itself is among the first-line agents for migraine prevention
edits.replacement: Propranolol for migraine prevention, tremor, anxiety symptoms and thyroid storm; metoprolol is also used for migraine prevention
edits.reason: UNSAFE: 'among the first-line agents' is an overstated certainty not supported by the NHS source (metoprolol is not a licensed UK migraine preventive); softened to the supported statement that it is used for this.

notes: Line-by-line check. NHS excerpts support: headaches, tiredness, dizziness, nausea, cold hands/feet, slow heartbeat, breathlessness as common effects that ease with time; dizziness at start or after dose increase; alcohol caution; sexual side effects with limited evidence; long-term use safe; tell the anaesthetist; heart-failure warning signs (cough on exertion, swollen ankles, irregular heartbeat); beta-blocker cautions (asthma, uncontrolled heart failure, heart block, low blood pressure). No dose figure added; pre-patch taper instruction ('over one to two weeks') was removed by the writers and replaced with 'reduced gradually' (safer). Clonidine/digoxin/amiodarone interactions, succinate survival benefit in heart failure and modified-release handling are standard StatPearls/BNF content. No protected field changed.
